rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: 2025年6月、血管インターベンション事業のほぼ全てを約8.25億ドルで買収
relations.text_en: Acquired substantially all of its Vascular Intervention business in June 2025 for about $825 million

source.label: Teleflex 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On June 30, 2025, we acquired substantially all of the Vascular Intervention business of BIOTRONIK SE & Co.

relations.text: 2026年8月、Kohlbergと共にTeleflexのOEM事業を15億ドルで買収
relations.text_en: Bought Teleflex's OEM business with Kohlberg for $1.5 billion in August 2026

source.label: Teleflex 2026年第3四半期決算発表
source.quote: on August 3, 2026, the Company completed the divestiture of its OEM business to Montagu and Kohlberg, for $1.5 billion in cash.

relations.text: 2026年8月、Montaguと共にTeleflexのOEM事業を15億ドルで買収
relations.text_en: Bought Teleflex's OEM business with Montagu for $1.5 billion in August 2026

source.label: Teleflex 2026年第3四半期決算発表
source.quote: on August 3, 2026, the Company completed the divestiture of its OEM business to Montagu and Kohlberg, for $1.5 billion in cash.

relations.text: Teleflexの急性期医療・泌尿器インターベンション事業を買収予定(審査中)
relations.text_en: Pending buyer of Teleflex's Acute Care and Interventional Urology businesses

source.label: Teleflex 2026年第3四半期決算発表
source.quote: The Company continues to advance the pending sale of its Acute Care and Interventional Urology businesses to Intersurgical Ltd., and the regulatory review process is progressing.

relations.text: Haemoneticsが10-Kで、血管閉鎖デバイスの主な競合としてTeleflexを挙げる
relations.text_en: Haemonetics names Teleflex among its main vascular closure competitors

source.label: Haemonetics 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Our main competitors in vascular access closure include Terumo BCT, Abbott Laboratories, Cordis, and Teleflex

companies.name: メリット・メディカル

relations.text: Merit Medicalが10-Kで、心臓インターベンション市場の主な競合としてTeleflexを挙げる
relations.text_en: Merit Medical names Teleflex among its primary cardiac intervention competitors

source.label: Merit Medical 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our primary competitors in our cardiac intervention market are BD, Teleflex, Medtronic, Abbott Laboratories, Terumo Corporation, Edwards Lifesciences Corporation, Cook Medical, and Boston Scientific.

relations.text: ICU Medicalが10-Kで、競合製品のメーカーとしてTeleflexを挙げる
relations.text_en: ICU Medical names Teleflex among makers of products it competes with

source.label: ICU Medical 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We compete with products and systems marketed by Becton Dickinson ("BD"), Baxter International ("Baxter"), B. Braun Medical, Inc. ("B. Braun"), Angiodynamics, Teleflex, EquaShield and Medtronic.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
